claims.v: records and documents of the IC and DoD, oral history interviews, open source analysis, interviews of current and former government officials, classified and unclassified archives
claims.quote: is based upon the records and documents of the IC and DoD, oral history interviews, open source analysis, interviews of current and former government officials, and classified and unclassified archives

claims.v: reviewed all official USG investigatory efforts since 1945, researched classified and unclassified archives, conducted approximately 30 interviews
claims.quote: AARO reviewed all official USG investigatory efforts since 1945, researched classified and unclassified archives, conducted approximately 30 interviews

claims.v: not to prove or disprove any belief set, but to investigate past USG-sponsored UAP investigation efforts and interviewee claims with a rigorous analytic and scientific approach
claims.quote: The goal of this report is not to prove or disprove any particular belief set, but rather to use a rigorous analytic and scientific approach to investigate past USG-sponsored UAP investigation efforts

claims.v: claims by interviewees that the USG and various contractors have recovered and are hiding off-world technology and biological material
claims.quote: the claims made by interviewees that the USG and various contractors have recovered and are hiding off-world technology and biological material

claims.v: narrative that the USG, or a secretive organization within it, recovered several off-world spacecraft and extraterrestrial biological remains, reverse engineers the technology, and has hidden this since the 1940s
claims.quote: a particularly persistent narrative that the USG-or a secretive organization within it-recovered several off-world spacecraft and extraterrestrial biological remains

claims.v: alleged conspiracy since the 1940s to keep the effort hidden from Congress and the American public
claims.quote: that it has conspired since the 1940s to keep this effort hidden from the United States Congress and the American public

claims.v: approximately two dozen separate USG investigative efforts since 1945
claims.quote: This research revealed the existence of approximately two dozen separate investigative efforts, depending on how they are counted.

claims.v: to determine whether UAP represented a flight safety risk, technological leaps by competitor nations, or evidence of off-world technology under intelligent control
claims.quote: Since 1945, the USG has funded and supported UAP investigations with the goal of determining whether UAP represented a flight safety risk, technological leaps by competitor nations, or evidence of off-world technology under intelligent control.

claims.v: No USG investigation, academic-sponsored research, or official review panel has confirmed that any UAP sighting represented extraterrestrial technology
claims.quote: AARO found no evidence that any USG investigation, academic-sponsored research, or official review panel has confirmed that any sighting of a UAP represented extraterrestrial technology.

claims.v: All investigative efforts concluded most sightings were ordinary objects and phenomena and the result of misidentification
claims.quote: All investigative efforts, at all levels of classification, concluded that most sightings were ordinary objects and phenomena and the result of misidentification.

claims.v: All official foreign UAP investigatory efforts to date reached the same general conclusions as USG investigations
claims.quote: all official foreign UAP investigatory efforts to date have reached the same general conclusions as USG investigations

claims.v: Most unsolved cases could be identified and resolved as ordinary objects or phenomena if more and better quality data were available
claims.quote: AARO assesses that if more and better quality data were available, most of these cases also could be identified and resolved as ordinary objects or phenomena.

claims.v: The vast majority of cases lack actionable data or the data available is limited or of poor quality
claims.quote: the vast majority of cases lack actionable data or the data available is limited or of poor quality

claims.v: Resources and staffing for UAP investigation programs have largely been irregular and sporadic
claims.quote: Resources and staffing for these programs largely have been irregular and sporadic, challenging investigatory efforts and hindering effective knowledge transfer.

claims.v: The vast majority of reports almost certainly result from misidentification and the lack of domain awareness
claims.quote: The vast majority of reports almost certainly are the result of misidentification and a direct consequence of the lack of domain awareness

claims.v: No empirical evidence that the USG and private companies have been reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology
claims.quote: AARO found no empirical evidence for claims that the USG and private companies have been reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology.

claims.v: Claims involving specific people, known locations, technological tests and documents allegedly related to reverse-engineering of extraterrestrial technology are inaccurate
claims.quote: technological tests, and documents allegedly involved in or related to the reverse-engineering of extraterrestrial technology, are inaccurate

claims.v: Interviewees named authentic classified USG programs but mistakenly associated them with alien and extraterrestrial activity
claims.quote: the interviewees mistakenly associated these authentic USG programs with alien and extraterrestrial activity

claims.v: No evidence of any authentic UAP-related nondisclosure agreement or of threats of death or violence for disclosing UAP information
claims.quote: AARO has found no evidence of any authentic UAP-related NDA or other evidence threatening death or violence for disclosing UAP information.

claims.v: The named former CIA official was not involved in the movement of extraterrestrial technology and signed a memo rejecting the interviewees' claim
claims.quote: The named, former CIA official was not involved in the movement of extraterrestrial technology. The same former CIA officer signed a memo rejecting a claim made by interviewees that he managed the movement of and experimentation on off-world technology.

claims.v: An interviewee who overheard a conversation about a technology test at a military base where 'aliens' allegedly were observing misunderstood the conversation
claims.quote: related to an account of an interviewee overhearing a conversation about a technology test at a military base where "aliens" allegedly were observing, and AARO judges that the interviewee misunderstood the conversation.

claims.v: Claim that a named former military officer physically touched an extraterrestrial spacecraft is inaccurate; the officer denied it on the record and recounted touching an F-117 Nighthawk
claims.quote: claim that a named former military officer explained in detail how he physically touched an extraterrestrial spacecraft is inaccurate. The claim was denied on the record by the named former officer who recounted a story of when he touched an F-117 Nighthawk stealth fighter that could have been misconstrued by the interviewee

claims.v: An interviewee's claimed witnessing of extraterrestrial technology testing at a USG facility almost certainly was an authentic, non-UAP-related technology test
claims.quote: believed to be the testing of extraterrestrial technology at a USG facility almost certainly was an observation of an authentic, non-UAP-related, technology test that strongly correlated in time, location, and description provided in the interviewee's account.

claims.v: No evidence that U.S. companies ever possessed off-world technology; executives, scientists and chief technology officers of the named companies denied it on the record
claims.quote: AARO has found no evidence that U.S. companies ever possessed off-world technology.

claims.v: All named alleged hidden UAP reverse-engineering programs either do not exist, are misidentified authentic sensitive national security programs, or resolve to an unwarranted and disestablished program
claims.quote: highly sensitive national security programs that are not related to extraterrestrial technology exploitation; or resolve to an unwarranted and disestablished program

claims.v: None of the interviewees had firsthand knowledge of the named programs
claims.quote: It is important to note that none of the interviewees had firsthand knowledge of these programs-they were not approved for access to nor did they work on these efforts

claims.v: In 2021 the scope of an IC Controlled Access Program was expanded without sufficient justification to protect UAP reverse-engineering; it never recovered or reverse-engineered anything and was disestablished
claims.quote: In 2021, without sufficient justification, the scope of an IC Controlled Access Program was expanded to protect UAP reverse-engineering. This program never recovered or reverse-engineered any UAP or extraterrestrial spacecraft. This IC program was disestablished due to its lack of merit.

claims.v: The claim that the USG is reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology and hiding it from Congress is largely the result of circular reporting from a group of believers
claims.quote: is, in large part, the result of circular reporting from a group of individuals who believe this to be the case, despite the lack of any evidence
